# M1-07 — Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) v1

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-high`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Create the RTM structure: Stakeholder/Source → Requirement → Acceptance Criteria → (future: Design/Issue/Test/Release)
- [ ] Populate the RTM with all baselined FRs and NFRs
- [ ] Ensure every requirement uses a stable, unique identifier
- [ ] Trace at least one requirement fully end-to-end for the evidence currently available
- [ ] Store the RTM as a live artefact in the repository (not a static screenshot)
- [ ] Link the RTM from PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- RTM covers 100% of baselined FRs/NFRs with source and acceptance-criteria links.
- Identifiers are consistent with those used in the FR/NFR registers.
- At least one requirement is traced end-to-end and the team can present it live.
- Structure anticipates later columns (design, issue/PR, test, release) without requiring them yet.
